title: Forensic Disciplines (Overview)
notes: This module is an educational overview. Methods and admissibility standards vary.
All forensic conclusions require clear limits, error rates where known, and documented methodology.

disciplines.title: Fingerprint Examination
disciplines.scope: Comparison of ridge detail patterns to assess correspondence.

disciplines.title: DNA Analysis
disciplines.scope: Biological sample profiling to assess contributor likelihoods.
quality_controls: Clear interpretation language (avoid absolute claims without basis)

disciplines.title: Toxicology (Conceptual)
disciplines.scope: Detect substances in biological samples for context in impairment or exposure questions.
notes: Education-only; no dosing or medical interpretation provided here.

disciplines.title: Firearms / Toolmarks (Conceptual)
disciplines.scope: Comparison of marks and trajectories at a high level.
notes: Avoid operational details; focus on documentation and limits.

disciplines.title: Digital Forensics (Conceptual)
disciplines.scope: Preserve and analyze digital artifacts with integrity controls.
quality_controls: Reproducibility, audit logging, preservation of originals

disciplines.title: Trace Evidence (Conceptual)
disciplines.scope: Small material transfers (fibers, glass, paint) to assess contact hypotheses.

disciplines.title: Forensic Photography (Conceptual)
disciplines.scope: Neutral documentation of scenes and items.
